title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Blue Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Blue Raspberry Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit delivers a sweet and tangy berry flavour with a confectionery-inspired twist. Juicy and vibrant, this flavour balances ripe Blue Raspberry sweetness with a bright, tart edge for a classic fruit vape that’s both punchy and satisfying. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is designed for exclusive use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods connect magnetically and work seamlessly with the device’s twist-to-switch dual pod system, making it easy to enjoy different flavours throughout the day. This 2-pack of Blue Raspberry pods is perfect for topping up your favourite Edition kit or building your own custom pairing from the full Pyne Pod flavour range.
